content.title: Pactiv Evergreen closing manufacturing plant next to Meadows Field Airport
content.summary: An Oildale manufacturing plant that makes plastic packaging for supermarkets and restaurants will close later this year, eliminating 127 jobs not long after its parent company was bought by a private equity firm. Illinois-based Pactiv Evergreen informed local authorities last week that all workers at the 19-acre facility at the northeast corner of Norris Road and Pegasus Drive will be let go ...

content.title: Novolex completes $6.7B acquisition of Pactiv Evergreen
content.summary: Pactiv Evergreen has transitioned from a publicly traded to privately held company as it is absorbed under Novolex. The combined company becomes one of largest food packaging producers.

content.title: Pactiv Evergreen settles for $6.25M over 2023 North Carolina mill closure
content.summary: The restitution amount is more than half of what Pactiv Evergreen received from the state in grants for the site. The company is “pleased to have resolved” matters related to the Canton mill, which it sold last month.

thumbnail.caption: Pactiv Evergreen closed its paper mill in Canton, North Carolina, in 2023. In February 2025, the company settled for $6.25 million with North Carolina over closing the mill after accepting state grant funding to keep it open through 2024.
